screens.title: Telemetry
screens.content: Measured local-AI usage on this device, estimated cost versus cloud LLM APIs, privacy, performance and reliability
screens.required_exception: Every number is labeled Measured, Estimated or Not measured; healthcare outcomes stay Not measured
access_guards: Public informational page; no session or patient state required.
Shows content-free aggregates only; never a case, actor, text or exact time.
validation_rules: Every figure carries a Measured, Estimated or Not measured badge, and every estimate shows its formula and assumptions.
Cloud cost is estimated from measured tokens and reviewed list prices with source and date; no cloud call is made and cloud latency is not shown.
Healthcare outcomes and savings stay Not measured (R39); synthetic runs are never counted as avoided visits.
No request leaves the device: charts are bundled and prices are never fetched at run time (R34).
While a guest session is open, the session-expiry warning (2 minutes before the end, with Stay signed in) shows on this page too (#399, R36, WCAG 2.2.1).

Opened from the presenter tools it renders in the presenter shell at /presenter/telemetry, the same screen (no new screen ID; the 25 screen routes are unchanged), so the presenter keeps the presenter navigation (#470, CHG-DEV-API-007).

Every figure counts the selected period up to now, including the current hour (#638, ADR-017 amendment 6): Last 24 hours and Last 7 days are rolling windows ending now, Since this release runs from the release start to now. The page names the window as an absolute UTC start ("since 20 Oct 2026, 15:00 UTC"), with the outcome counting start when it is later (#324, #325). Outcome figures without samples say that none have been counted in the window yet.

Per-consultation figures (the calculator's token, energy and AI-time defaults, the privacy sentence and the slide's scenario) divide usage and consultations from the same named window; the measured volume divides the counted consultations by the days actually counted; each default says whether it is measured or a fallback, and the slide keeps that basis (#398, #468, #477).
Mock mode presents scripted calls and guidance as scripted: no AI model, model timing or network check is shown as running or measured, and the slide's title says mock mode (#437).

Calculator fields can be emptied while typing; an empty, negative or out-of-range entry (a lifetime under 1 month) is marked with a message and the results keep the last valid value (#438, #439). The minute-by-minute update can be stopped (#446).

screens.title: Adaptive questions
screens.content: One question, options and optional explanation
screens.required_exception: Not sure, skip, retry, conflict or urgent interrupt
access_guards: Valid session and current consent.
Authorize ownership of caseId and all nested resource IDs on every request.
Enforce current case state/revision on direct navigation and button actions.
validation_rules: One question at a time; at most 10 issued slots, including skipped slots.
Use exactly the issued question and option IDs; single_choice, multiple_choice, scale, text, duration and unknown/skipped follow the master contract.
Answered text is 1 to 2000 characters after trimming; missing scale value is not zero.
Editing an existing answer does not issue another slot; duplicate submission must not issue extra questions.
Recheck urgency after every answer; urgent interruption precedes the next normal action.
At phone width one progress indicator reads "Step 4 of 8 · Question n of up to 10" with one bar; wider screens keep the step list and the question line (#348).

From question 2 on, "Previous question" shows the earlier issued question with its saved answer filled in (repeatable back to question 1; "Back to question n" returns). An unchanged answer returns to the current question without saving; a changed one is saved with saveAnswer (revision-checked; urgent screening applies) and every later question and answer is kept, because the issue order does not depend on answers; the page says so before saving (#357).

An answer error is tied to the answer: the choice group, scale or text field gets aria-invalid and names the error with aria-describedby; the text answer's accessible name includes the question (#404).

screens.content: Synthetic fixtures, mode and run evidence; three one-click flows that run live on the device (CHG-DEV-API-006); full journeys and reset in the secondary view /presenter/scenarios/more
screens.primary_action: Run a quick flow; on More scenarios, load a full journey or reset
screens.required_exception: Reset failure blocks a new guest demo
access_guards: Authenticated presenter role; enforce on API as well as route navigation.
validation_rules: Load only explicitly selected synthetic scenarios.
Reset revokes/cancels prior work; delayed work cannot restore cleared data.
A failed reset blocks the next demo until repaired.
Presenter-only in the target local product; the original open-access browser mock is a separate reference.

Loading or showing opens one reused patient tab at the case's screen; an Open on patient site link is always available (#315). Since #487 the patient tab opens /app/... on the same address in the patient role (patient pages call the patient API, presenter pages the presenter API).

The Scenarios page shows only three quick flows (Guidance from the local AI, Self-care guidance, Urgent warning sign) and one line of device status; each flow runs live at its one click with every synthetic input ready, shows progress with the device name and the elapsed seconds, and never substitutes a result for a failure (#358).
Full journeys and the reset are the secondary view /presenter/scenarios/more of this screen (no new screen ID); the presenter navigation lists Scenarios first (#358).

Reset removes every demo session and synthetic case created from this browser's presenter tools, including those of its earlier presenter sessions (an HttpOnly presenter-lineage cookie ties them together); patient guest sessions and another presenter browser's demos are never touched (#396, CHG-DEV-API-007).

Whether the last reset blocks a new demo, and which demo cases the patient tab can still open, come from the server (getRuntime `demo`) on every load, refresh and return to the tab, on both views; a presenter-session problem shows the presenter gate and never claims that a reset ran or failed (#422, #425, #426, #460).

A quick flow keeps running when the presenter leaves or reloads the page: the patient tab ends on the result (or a fresh one closes on a failure) and the card shows the outcome on return; a finished run whose demo session ended or was reset says Expired instead of offering Show again; full journeys wait while a flow runs (#423, #424, #426).

Status text says only what happened: no "opened in the patient tab" when the browser blocked it, no "answers live" for a branch that stops before the AI, and a sub-second step never reads as 0 s; a running flow's accessible name contains its visible label (#430, #462, #443).

#548: a quick flow opens no tab while it runs: a dialog on the presenter screen shows the flow name, the device, the step from the prepare job's real stage (loading the scenario, checking for warning signs, writing, checking the guidance; never a percentage), the elapsed seconds and the device's usual time, with Close (there is no cancel operation; the run continues and its card shows it). Done: the outcome and Open the result, which opens the patient tab inside that click. Failed: the honest reason, Nothing was substituted, Try again and Close. Focus stays in the dialog, Escape closes it and focus returns to the Run button.
